rationale: The agent appears to have executed an exchange (tool call exchange_delivered_order_items) without first confirming the order-changing action with the user or confirming the payment method, violating the policy requirement to confirm every order-changing write. The agent also looked up product_id 4760268021 but exchanged to new_item_id 9844888101, indicating a mismatch and no explicit verification that the replacement matches the requested specs. There is no visible confirmation of which laptop item from the user’s multiple orders was being exchanged, nor any final details (cost differences, return/ship instructions). While the agent did identify the user via name+zip and accessed only that user’s orders, the lack of confirmation before writing and incomplete final information makes this fail the pass bar.
